entries.requirement: document assignment as intentionally leaving container/observer membership untouched, deferring identity transfer to an explicit swap
explicitly unregister an object's own address from every external observer list it is currently registered on before adopting new state
guard copy assignment against self-assignment before mutating any state
use the copy-and-swap idiom so the old state's own destructor performs cleanup

Correctly implement copy assignment for a type that registers itself, by its own address, as an observer/auditor on external containers reachable from its current state (like SoPath registering itself on each node's SoChildList so scene-graph edits notify it), so that assigning a new route unregisters the old observation exactly once, registers the new one exactly once, and self-assignment is a safe no-op.
